name: Highball
instructions: Pour ice, whisky, 1 wedge of lime and club soda into glass. Stir.

name: Gin Fizz
ingredients: Gin 60ml, Sour mix 30ml, Club soda top
instructions: Pour ice, gin, sour mix and club soda into glass. Stir.

name: Vodka Soda Lime
instructions: Pour ice, vodka, 1 wedge of lime and club soda into glass. Stir.

name: Vodka Cranberry
instructions: Pour ice, vodka and cranberry juice into glass. Stir.

name: Vodka Orange
instructions: Pour ice, vodka and orange juice into glass. Stir.

name: Rum Coke
instructions: Pour ice, rum and coke into glass. Stir.

name: Captain Morgan Coke
instructions: Pour ice, Captain Morgan and coke into glass. Stir.

name: Captain Morgan Ginger Ale
instructions: Pour ice, Captain Morgan and ginger ale into glass. Stir.

name: Whisky Soda
instructions: Pour ice, whisky and club soda into glass. Stir.

name: Whisky Coke
instructions: Pour ice, whisky and coke into glass. Stir.

name: Whisky Ginger Ale
instructions: Pour ice, whisky and ginger ale into glass. Stir.

name: Tequila Sunrise
ingredients: Tequila 60ml, Orange juice top, Grenadine syrup 10ml
instructions: Pour ice, tequila and orange juice into glass. Stir and top with grenadine syrup.

name: Sex on the Beach
ingredients: Vodka 20ml, Peach liqueur 40ml, Cranberry juice top (90%), Orange juice top
instructions: Pour ice, vodka, peach liqueur and cranberry juice into glass. Stir and top with orange juice.

name: Vodka Lime
instructions: Cut 1/2 lime into thirds, and then into thirds again (total 9 pieces of lime). In a shaker, put the lime, sugar and vodka. Add ice, shake, pour into glass.

name: Caipirinha
instructions: Cut 1/2 lime into thirds, and then into thirds again (total 9 pieces of lime). In a shaker, put the lime, sugar and cachaca. Add ice, shake, pour into glass.

name: Melon Highball
ingredients: Whisky 20ml, Melon liqueur 40ml, Orange juice 10ml, Club soda top
instructions: Pour ice, whisky, melon liqueur, 1 wedge of lime, orange juice and club soda into glass. Stir.
